title: The Metric That Lies: Why Automation Rate Is the Wrong Number to Lead With, and the Four We Report Instead
summary: Every mortgage AI pitch leads with an automation rate, and it is the one number that can be high while the deployment is failing. A straight-through rate rises when you lower the confidence floor, which is also how confident errors start reaching the loan. The four measurements we actually hold a mortgage deployment to, why the exception rate matters more than the automation rate, and how SR 11-7 and the NIST AI RMF turn these from a dashboard into a control.
